# Muhammad Tanveer Abbas, full profile

> AI native product builder. Designs and ships AI products end to end, from the interface down to the agents and the data plumbing behind them.

Canonical page: https://themvpguy.vercel.app/
Short summary: https://themvpguy.vercel.app/llms.txt
Last reviewed: 2026-10-15

## Who he is

Muhammad Tanveer Abbas is an AI native product builder. He takes a product from idea to a live, working build. That covers the interface people see, the agents and models behind it, and the database, auth and payments plumbing that holds it together.

He works as a single builder rather than a hand off chain, so design, frontend, backend and deployment stay in one head.

## What he builds

- AI products and agent workflows that sit inside a real product, not beside it
- Web apps on Next.js and React with a TypeScript codebase throughout
- Interfaces with care for layout, motion, states and accessibility
- Backends on Postgres or Supabase with auth, storage and row level rules
- Payments and billing flows with Stripe
- Deployment and delivery on Vercel

## Stack

- Framework: Next.js, React
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- Runtime and APIs: Node.js
- Data and auth: Supabase, Postgres
- Payments: Stripe
- Hosting: Vercel
- 3D and motion: Three.js, GSAP

## This site

The site is a digital card, built with Next.js 16, React 19 and Tailwind CSS v4. It has a 3D tilting card, an animated border, skill badges, a copy to clipboard email, a resume download, and a light and dark theme.

- Source code: https://github.com/MuhammadTanveerAbbas/Devcard
- License: MIT
